raw_content:
rules:
- id: "vuln-git-client-plugin-75ea3fe0"
  pattern: File.createTempFile($PREFIX, $SUFFIX, $WORKSPACE)
  pattern-not: |
    File.createTempFile($PREFIX, $SUFFIX)
    File.createTempFile($PREFIX, $SUFFIX, $WORKSPACE)
    File.createTempFile($PREFIX, $SUFFIX, $WORKSPACE).toFile()
  languages: ["java"]
  message: "Use of File.createTempFile with explicit workspace parameter may lead to insecure temporary file creation. The patched version uses createTempFileInSystemDir or createTempFile methods that enforce proper permissions (rw-------) on Unix-like systems. Replace with custom createTempFile method that ensures secure temporary file creation with restricted permissions."
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    source-url: "github.com/jenkinsci/git-client-plugin/commit/75ea3fe05650fc6ca09046a72493e2b3f066fb98"
    category: security
    cwe: [CWE-377]
    owasp: [OWASP-M01]
    technology: java
    references:
      - "https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/Insecure_Temporary_File"
      - "https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/io/File.html#createTempFile-java.lang.String-java.lang.String-java.io.File-"
    remediation: "Replace File.createTempFile($PREFIX, $SUFFIX, $WORKSPACE) calls with custom createTempFile method that ensures secure temporary file creation with proper permissions on Unix-like systems."
  pattern-not-inside: |
    private File createTempFileInSystemDir(String prefix, String suffix) throws IOException {
        ...
    }
    private File createTempFile(String prefix, String suffix) throws IOException {
        ...
    }
